title: 6.5 Game viewer page — real-time Snake canvas
description: Game viewer page (`/rooms/:code/play`): HTML5 Canvas rendering the Snake grid in real time. Subscribes to `/topic/room/{code}` WebSocket for game state. Renders snakes (color per player), food, walls, scores overlay. Responsive canvas sizing.

title: 6.1 Scaffold React + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui
description: Scaffold React app with Vite in `frontend/` directory. TypeScript template. Install TailwindCSS v4 + shadcn/ui. Configure proxy to Spring Boot backend (port 8080) in vite.config.ts for development. Add `.gitignore` for node_modules.

title: 2.1 RoomService
description: Create `RoomService` in `me._on.codingdojo.server.room`. Operations: create room (generates short-code + shareable link), find by code, list rooms, delete room. Uses `RoomRepository` (Spring Data JPA) for persistence.

title: Epic 3: Game Engine Core
description: Pluggable game loop that is game-type agnostic. GameEngine interface, session management, tick-based game loop, map loading.

title: 8.2 Integration test: full game lifecycle
description: Full game lifecycle integration test: `@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = RANDOM_PORT)` + Testcontainers. Create room → 2 bots join → start game → play N rounds (bots submit random moves) → verify game ends → verify leaderboard/results. Tests the entire stack end-to-end.

title: 1.3 GameState base model
description: Create abstract/sealed `GameState` base class in `me._on.codingdojo.server.model` with fields: `roomId`, `roundNumber`, `tickNumber`, `status` (enum), `playerStates` map. Concrete game types (Snake, etc.) extend this.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests: verify abstract/sealed base construction, field accessors, playerStates map manipulation, JSON polymorphic serialization with concrete subclass.

title: 3.7 Unit tests for GameLoop and GameManager
description: Unit tests (JUnit 5 + Mockito) for GameLoop and GameManager. Test tick sequencing, round transitions, game-over detection with a mock GameEngine implementation.

title: 4.4 Snake map configs
description: Create YAML map config files in `src/main/resources/maps/snake/` — at least two maps: `classic.yaml` (open 20x20 grid) and `obstacles.yaml` (30x30 with walls). Define grid size, obstacle positions, spawn points.

title: 5.1 GameController (REST)
description: Create `GameController` in `me._on.codingdojo.server.api`. `GET /api/game/{roomCode}/state` — current state for authenticated player. `POST /api/game/{roomCode}/move` — submit move. Protected by TokenAuthFilter (Bearer token).

title: 8.4 Rate-limiting / anti-cheat for moves
description: Throttle move submissions: one move per tick per player. Reject out-of-turn or duplicate moves with 429 Too Many Requests. Implement in GameSession or as a filter. Prevents clients from flooding the server.

title: 3.3 GameLoop service
description: Create `GameLoop` @Service in `me._on.codingdojo.server.engine`. Runs a scheduled tick loop (ScheduledExecutorService). Each tick: collects moves from session, calls `engine.tick()`, broadcasts new state. Manages start/stop per room.

title: 7.5 Unit tests for stats
description: Unit tests for StatsCollector and FunnyStatsGenerator (JUnit 5 + Mockito). Verify stat accumulation across rounds, funny stat derivation logic, edge cases (single player, all players die same tick, zero food eaten).

title: 2.3 RoomController
description: Create `RoomController` in `me._on.codingdojo.server.api`. REST endpoints: `POST /api/rooms` (create room), `GET /api/rooms/{code}` (room details), `POST /api/rooms/{code}/join` (register player, returns token). Returns room details + player token on join.

title: 1.6 GameConfig properties class
description: Create `GameConfig` as a `@ConfigurationProperties(prefix = \"dojo.game\")` class in `me._on.codingdojo.server.config` with defaults: tickRateMs, maxPlayers, defaultRoundCount. Add matching YAML section to application.yaml.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests: verify @ConfigurationProperties binding from YAML, default values, custom overrides. Test that invalid values are rejected.

title: 1b.1 Enable JPA + PostgreSQL + Liquibase + Testcontainers in pom.xml
description: Uncomment `spring-boot-starter-data-jpa` in pom.xml. Add PostgreSQL driver dependency (`org.postgresql:postgresql`). Add Liquibase dependency (`org.liquibase:liquibase-core`). Add Testcontainers dependencies (postgresql, junit-jupiter) for test scope. Add `spring-boot-testcontainers` starter.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests: verify build succeeds with new dependencies, no version conflicts. Smoke test that Spring context starts.

title: 4.1 SnakeGameState
description: Create `SnakeGameState` in `me._on.codingdojo.server.game.snake` extending `GameState`. Adds: grid (2D), snake positions (linked list of coordinates per player), food positions, direction per snake, alive/dead status per player.

title: 1b.2 Datasource & Liquibase configuration in application.yaml
description: Add PostgreSQL datasource config to application.yaml (spring.datasource.url, username, password). Add spring.jpa.hibernate.ddl-auto=validate (Liquibase manages schema). Add spring.liquibase config pointing to `db/changelog/db.changelog-master.yaml`. Create application-test.yaml pointing to Testcontainers dynamic datasource.

title: 6.7 Serve React build from Spring Boot + CORS config
description: Configure Spring Boot to serve the React production build. Options: (a) copy Vite build output into `src/main/resources/static/` via Maven plugin, or (b) configure CORS for separate deployment. Add a catch-all forward controller for SPA client-side routing (forward non-API requests to index.html).

title: 4.2 SnakeMove enum
description: Create `SnakeMove` enum in `me._on.codingdojo.server.game.snake`: `UP`, `DOWN`, `LEFT`, `RIGHT`, `NONE` (no-op / timeout default).

title: 8.5 API documentation (springdoc-openapi + Swagger UI)
description: Add `springdoc-openapi-starter-webmvc-ui` dependency. Annotate controllers with `@Operation` / `@Tag`. Auto-generated Swagger UI at `/swagger-ui.html`. Useful for client developers to explore the API.

title: 3.6 GameEngineRegistry
description: Create `GameEngineRegistry` @Component in `me._on.codingdojo.server.engine`. Collects all `GameEngine` beans by name (strategy pattern via `Map<String, GameEngine>`). GameManager looks up the correct engine by `room.gameType`.

title: Epic 2: Room & Player Management
description: In-memory management of rooms and players. No persistence yet (JPA later as P3).

title: Epic 7: Leaderboard & Funny Stats
description: Post-game leaderboard and humorous statistics (superlatives, achievements). In-game scoreboard tracking.

title: Epic 5: Game REST API + WebSocket
description: REST endpoints for game play + WebSocket (STOMP) configuration for real-time game state push. Clients poll/submit moves via REST; spectators and front-end receive state via WebSocket.

title: 2.4 TokenAuthFilter
description: Create `TokenAuthFilter` (OncePerRequestFilter or HandlerInterceptor) in `me._on.codingdojo.server.api.auth`. Reads `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header on `/api/game/**` routes and sets the authenticated Player on the request context.

title: 5.2 AdminController (start/stop game)
description: Create `AdminController` in `me._on.codingdojo.server.api`. `POST /api/rooms/{code}/start` — host starts game. `POST /api/rooms/{code}/stop` — host force-stops. Validates caller is room host.

title: Epic 8: Integration Tests, E2E & Polish
description: Test client for integration testing (Testcontainers + SpringBootTest), Playwright E2E tests, API documentation, rate-limiting. PostgreSQL persistence is promoted to its own new epic (Epic 1b) since it's foundational now.

title: 4.3 SnakeEngine
description: Create `SnakeEngine` implementing `GameEngine` in `me._on.codingdojo.server.game.snake`. Logic: move snakes in direction, detect wall/self/other collisions, spawn food randomly, grow snake on eat, scoring (food eaten + survival). Register as Spring bean named "snake".

title: 3.4 GameManager service
description: Create `GameManager` @Service in `me._on.codingdojo.server.engine`. Orchestrates full lifecycle: start game → run N rounds → determine winner → finalize. Bridges RoomService, GameLoop, and GameEngine. Late-join behavior: new players can register during a running game but appear on the game field and leaderboard only after the server receives their first API request (state poll or move). Until then they are registered but inactive — prevents ghost entries from players who never connected a client.

title: 1b.4 Testcontainers base configuration for integration tests
description: Create `@TestConfiguration` class with `@ServiceConnection` for PostgreSQL Testcontainers. This provides a shared PostgresContainer for all integration tests. Create a base `AbstractIntegrationTest` class that other tests extend.

title: Epic 1: Domain Models & Core Configuration
description: Foundation layer — all domain models, DTOs, and base configuration that everything else depends on. All classes use Lombok.
acceptance_criteria: All model classes have unit tests verifying builder/constructor, equals/hashCode, and serialization. Epic-level: component test validating all models can be serialized to/from JSON correctly together.

title: 4.5 Unit tests for SnakeEngine
description: Unit tests for `SnakeEngine` (JUnit 5). Cover: collision detection (wall, self, other snake), food eating/growth, direction changes, wall-kill behavior, scoring, edge cases (simultaneous head-on collision).

title: Epic 1b: PostgreSQL Persistence Layer
description: PostgreSQL persistence layer using Spring Data JPA + Flyway migrations. Uncomment JPA in pom.xml, add PostgreSQL driver, configure datasource in application.yaml. Testcontainers for integration tests. This is foundational — Room, Player, GameResult are all persisted.
acceptance_criteria: Epic-level: component test that Spring context loads with PostgreSQL Testcontainer, Liquibase migrations run, and repositories can perform basic CRUD.

title: 3.1 GameEngine interface
description: Create `GameEngine` interface in `me._on.codingdojo.server.engine`. Contract methods: `initState(Room, MapConfig) → GameState`, `tick(GameState, Map<UUID, Move>) → GameState`, `isRoundOver(GameState) → boolean`. Each game type implements this.

title: 8.1 TestClient utility (RestClient-based)
description: Create `TestClient` utility under `src/test/` using Spring `RestClient`. Operations: create room, join room, poll state, submit move. Used by integration tests to simulate full game flows. Runs against `@SpringBootTest(webEnvironment = RANDOM_PORT)` with Testcontainers PostgreSQL.

title: Epic 4: Snake Game Implementation
description: First concrete game type — Snake. Implements the GameEngine interface with snake-specific state, moves, collision, food, scoring.

title: 5.5 WebMvcTest for GameController + AdminController
description: `@WebMvcTest(GameController.class)` slice test with MockMvc. Test polling state, submitting moves, auth rejection (missing/invalid token). Also test AdminController start/stop endpoints.

title: 2.2 PlayerService
description: Create `PlayerService` in `me._on.codingdojo.server.room`. Operations: register player in room → generate and return token, validate token, lookup player by token or id. Uses `PlayerRepository` (Spring Data JPA) for persistence.

title: 6.4 Lobby page — join game + player list + token copy
description: Lobby page (`/rooms/:code`): Shows room info, player list (live-updated via WebSocket), join form (enter name → get token), copy-token button, "Start Game" button visible only to host. Uses STOMP client (@stomp/stompjs) to subscribe to `/topic/room/{code}/lobby`.

title: 2.5 Unit tests for RoomService / PlayerService
description: Unit tests (JUnit 5 + Mockito, no Spring context) for `RoomService` and `PlayerService`. Mock JPA repositories. Cover: create room, find by code, register player, token generation/validation, edge cases. Also create integration tests extending `AbstractIntegrationTest` (Testcontainers) for repository layer.

title: 1.2 Room model
description: Create `Room` model in `me._on.codingdojo.server.model` with fields: `id` (UUID), `code` (shareable short-code string), `name`, `hostPlayerId` (UUID), `status` enum (WAITING, RUNNING, FINISHED), `gameType` (String), `settings` (Map), `playerIds` (List<UUID>). Use Lombok.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests: verify builder, status enum values, equals/hashCode, JSON serialization of Room with all fields including playerIds list and settings map.

title: 1.1 Player model
description: Create `Player` model in `me._on.codingdojo.server.model` package with fields: `id` (UUID), `name` (String), `token` (String, auth token), `roomId` (UUID). Use Lombok `@Data`, `@Builder`.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests: verify builder, field defaults, equals/hashCode, JSON serialization/deserialization of Player.

title: 1.5 MoveRequest / MoveResponse DTOs
description: Create generic `MoveRequest` and `MoveResponse` DTOs in `me._on.codingdojo.server.model.dto`. MoveRequest carries the player's action (generic payload). MoveResponse carries the resulting game state snapshot for the player.
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests: verify MoveRequest/MoveResponse JSON serialization/deserialization, null handling, field validation.

title: 6.2 React Router + layout + API client
description: Set up React Router with routes: `/` (home), `/rooms/:code` (lobby), `/rooms/:code/play` (game viewer), `/rooms/:code/results` (post-game). Create layout component with shared header/nav. Set up API client (fetch wrapper) for REST calls to backend.

title: 3.2 GameSession class
description: Create `GameSession` class in `me._on.codingdojo.server.engine`. Holds the live `GameState`, collects pending moves from players in a thread-safe manner, references the `GameEngine`. One instance per running room.

title: Epic 6: React Front-End (Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui)
description: Front-end SPA built with React + Vite + TypeScript + TailwindCSS + shadcn/ui. Connects to backend via REST + WebSocket (STOMP). Replaces the earlier Thymeleaf plan. Serves from a separate dev server during development; production build can be served as static assets or standalone.

title: 1b.3 JPA entities + repositories for Player & Room
description: Convert `Player` and `Room` models to `@Entity` classes with JPA annotations. Create `PlayerRepository` and `RoomRepository` (Spring Data JPA interfaces). Create initial Liquibase changelog `src/main/resources/db/changelog/001-create-rooms-and-players.yaml`.

title: 2.6 WebMvcTest for RoomController
description: `@WebMvcTest(RoomController.class)` slice test with MockMvc. Cover all room endpoints: create, get, join. Verify JSON responses and HTTP status codes.

title: 1.7 Jackson JSON configuration
description: Create a `@Configuration` class in `me._on.codingdojo.server.config` that registers `JavaTimeModule` and sets sensible Jackson JSON defaults (camelCase naming).
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests: verify JavaTimeModule registration, Instant/LocalDateTime serialization format, camelCase naming in JSON output.

title: 6.6 Results page — leaderboard + funny stats display
description: Results page (`/rooms/:code/results`): Fetches leaderboard + funny stats from `GET /api/rooms/{code}/results`. Renders scoreboard table, podium visualization, funny stat cards with emojis. Uses shadcn/ui Table, Card, Badge components.

title: 3.5 MapConfig model + YAML loader
description: Create `MapConfig` POJO in `me._on.codingdojo.server.engine.map` (grid size, obstacles, spawn points) and a `MapLoader` utility that reads map definition YAML files from `classpath:maps/`.

title: 8.3 Playwright E2E tests for React frontend
description: Set up Playwright for E2E testing of the React front-end. Install Playwright in `frontend/`. Write E2E tests: create room flow, join room + copy token, game viewer loads and renders canvas, results page displays after game ends. Run against Spring Boot + React dev servers.

title: 7.2 StatsCollector service
description: Create `StatsCollector` @Service in `me._on.codingdojo.server.stats`. Listens to game events (round end, player death, food eaten) and accumulates `GameResult` data. Persists results to DB via `GameResultRepository` when game ends.

title: 7.3 FunnyStatsGenerator
description: Create `FunnyStatsGenerator` in `me._on.codingdojo.server.stats`. Derives humorous superlatives from GameResult data: "Most Suicidal 🐍", "Longest Survivor", "Wall Magnet", "Circle of Life Award" (ate the most food but died first), "Speed Demon", "Pacifist" (never killed anyone), etc.

title: 6.3 Home page — create room + room list
description: Home page (`/`): Create Room form (name, game type selector, settings). List of open/joinable rooms (cards). Uses shadcn/ui Card, Button, Input, Select components. Calls `POST /api/rooms` and displays room list from `GET /api/rooms`.

title: 7.4 StatsController
description: Create `StatsController` in `me._on.codingdojo.server.api`. `GET /api/rooms/{code}/results` — returns final leaderboard (sorted by score) + funny stats JSON. `GET /api/rooms/{code}/results/live` — current live scoreboard during game.

title: 5.4 GameBroadcastService (WebSocket push)
description: Create `GameBroadcastService` in `me._on.codingdojo.server.api`. After each game tick, publishes GameState to `/topic/room/{code}` via `SimpMessagingTemplate`. Called by GameLoop after each tick.

title: 7.1 GameResult model + entity
description: Create `GameResult` model/entity in `me._on.codingdojo.server.model`. Fields: id, roomId, playerId, playerName, totalScore, roundsSurvived, kills, foodEaten, causeOfDeath per round. JPA @Entity with Liquibase changelog migration.

title: 5.0 WebSocket STOMP configuration
description: Add `spring-boot-starter-websocket` to pom.xml. Create `WebSocketConfig` @Configuration enabling STOMP over WebSocket. Endpoint: `/ws`. Application destination prefix: `/app`. Topic prefix: `/topic` (e.g., `/topic/room/{code}` for game state broadcasts).

title: 1.4 Round model
description: Create `Round` model in `me._on.codingdojo.server.model` with fields: `roundNumber`, `mapConfig` reference, `duration`, `speed`, `scores` map (playerId → score).
acceptance_criteria: Unit tests: verify builder, scores map operations, JSON serialization of Round with mapConfig reference.

title: 5.3 Global error handling (@RestControllerAdvice)
description: Create global `@RestControllerAdvice` in `me._on.codingdojo.server.api.error`. Handle: `GameNotFoundException`, `InvalidMoveException`, `UnauthorizedException`, `RoomFullException` → proper HTTP status codes + JSON error body.
